Laravel 12 project; packages: inertiajs/inertia-laravel v2, laravel/fortify v1, laravel/framework v12, laravel/prompts v0, laravel/wayfinder v0, laravel/boost v2, laravel/mcp v0, laravel/pail v1, laravel/pint v1, laravel/sail v1, pestphp/pest v4, phpunit/phpunit v12. Follow installed-package-version documentation and project conventions.

This project has domain-specific skills available. You MUST activate the relevant skill whenever you work in that domain—don't wait until you're stuck.
`wayfinder-development` — Activate when referencing backend routes in frontend components, importing from `@/actions` or `@/routes`, calling Laravel routes from TypeScript, or using Wayfinder route functions.
`pest-testing` — Activate for tests, assertions, Livewire/browser testing, debugging failures, datasets, mocking, or when the user mentions test/spec/TDD/expect/assertion/coverage or asks to verify functionality.

Check sibling files for structure, approach, and naming. Use descriptive names; reuse existing components. Stick to existing directory structure; don't create new base folders without approval.
Do not create verification scripts or tinker when tests cover that functionality and prove they work. Unit and feature tests are more important.
Do not change the application's dependencies without approval.
You must only create documentation files if explicitly requested by the user.
Be concise in explanations.
Use Boost tools. Search documentation before code changes using `search-docs`; use multiple broad, simple topic queries, without package names. Pass package arrays when known. Use `list-artisan-commands` to check Artisan parameters; `get-absolute-url` for project URLs; `tinker` for PHP debugging/Eloquent queries; `database-query` for read-only database access; `database-schema` before migrations/models; `browser-logs` for recent browser logs only.

Always use curly braces for control structures, even for single-line bodies. Use PHP 8 constructor property promotion; do not allow empty `__construct()` methods with zero parameters unless private. Always use explicit return types and appropriate parameter type hints. Prefer PHPDoc blocks over inline comments. Never use comments within the code itself unless the logic is exceptionally complex. Add useful array shape types where appropriate. Use TitleCase enum keys.

Laravel Herd serves `https?://[kebab-case-project-dir].test`; use `get-absolute-url` for valid URLs. You must not run any commands to make the site available via HTTP(S). It is always available through Laravel Herd.
Every change must be programmatically tested. Write a new test or update an existing test, then run the affected tests to make sure they pass.
Run the minimum number of tests needed to ensure code quality and speed. Use `php artisan test --compact` with a specific filename or filter.

Inertia: pages are in `resources/js/pages` (unless `vite.config.js` says otherwise); use `Inertia::render()`, not Blade views. ALWAYS use `search-docs` for version-specific Inertia documentation. Check docs before using v1/v2 features; deferred props need an empty pulsing/animated skeleton.
Wayfinder: import from `@/actions/` (controllers) or `@/routes/` (named routes); use `wayfinder-development`. Supports invokable controllers, route-key binding, query merging, and Inertia `.form()`/`useForm`.

Laravel: use `php artisan make:` for files (`php artisan make:class` for generic PHP classes); pass `--no-interaction` and correct `--options`. Use rel
